def power_mod(base, exp, mod):
    result = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            result = (result * base) % mod
        base = (base * base) % mod
        exp >>= 1
    return result

def main():
    parts = input().split()
    n = int(parts[0])
    m = int(parts[1])
    L = int(parts[2])
    R = int(parts[3])

    mod = 998244353
    inv2 = power_mod(2, mod - 2, mod)
    diff = R - L + 1
    p1 = diff // 2
    p2 = diff - p1
    if (n * m) % 2 == 1:
        ans = power_mod(diff, n * m, mod)
    else:
        pp1 = diff
        pp2 = abs(p1 - p2)
        opt1 = power_mod(pp1, n * m, mod)
        opt2 = power_mod(pp2, n * m, mod)
        opt = (opt1 + opt2) % mod
        ans = (opt * inv2) % mod
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
